author: BRUH263618

title: Could be better
body:
First off I’d love to say how great this is, especially as someone who’s as forgetful as I am, and this is where it could be way better. As much as I think this app will help me it cannot satisfy my needs for number of tasks and it would be great if it could be more lenient for people who are forgetful, have ADHD etc. I have to write absolutely everything down to get things done and it would be nice if this could be considered. For me and my partner it is a let down to see because it would demotivate fully able people it therefore renders it partially useful for us and our needs. 

Other trackers haven’t worked well or been as easy to use, and the most effective we had was making our own on paper. But since our phones are always with us and it’s easier to track through phone like this it is way more beneficial for us to be able to put all the things we need to get done here.

I hope this can be a consideration at least to maybe allow for more or put it behind a mode to not deter people who tend to get unmotivated. 

Over all I’d love to applaud this app despite it being the first day in use, even though we have to supplement with something else.

author: Far for unge barn, Oslo

title: A little masterpiece
body:
I absolutely love Streaks. It’s one of the few apps that I’ve stuck to and use multiple times a day. The concept is simple and easy to understand, the design is clean and clutter free and tracking habits is as pain free as it gets. So the app actually does what it promises: Helping you stick to good habits. 

A couple of nifty features I really appreciate: 
- Automatic tracking using Apple Health data: Yes!! No double tracking of things your phone already knows. Just read the data that’s already there. No action needed.
- Customizable color theme: Go black! Perfect if you open the app after lights out:  no bright screen hurting your eyes.
- The perfect Watch app: complication on the watch face for a quick view of your daily task completion progress. Tap it, tap the habit you just completed and boom, you’re done. Timed habits too - just start the timer and get to work on whatever it is you’re tracking. The task autocompletes when the timer is up. That’s it. Pain free. 
- Suggestions for adjusting habits that are too easy or too hard: Find it hard to get all those steps? The app suggests a lower target so you don’t give up. Nailing it on your workout duration? The app suggests taking it up a notch to go from good habits  to great habits.

Streaks developers - you absolutely crushed it with this one. Congratulations!
